follow-up time: Not specified, but mentioned menstrual resumption and ability to conceive
cohort: 7 patients with placenta previa who underwent antepartum uterine artery embolization before vaginal delivery
finding: Uterine artery embolization allowed 5 out of 7 patients with placenta previa to have a vaginal delivery, while the remaining 2 with placenta accreta required hysterectomy.
mod_finding: Out of 7 patients with placenta previa who underwent uterine artery embolization, 5 had successful vaginal deliveries.
